critical_code_review_comments: core/views.py continues to grow (Organisation, Assessment, sign_checklist, timeline, verification_count, bulk_reassign etc.); split into modules before crossing 700 lines.
Print endpoints still accept ?token= via URL for window.open(), leaking tokens in access logs / Referer headers. Recommend signed one-time tokens or an HttpOnly cookie handshake.

OrganisationSerializer previously exposed logo via DRF default FileField serialisation, which calls request.build_absolute_uri() using the internal cluster hostname. That absolute URL was returned to the browser and produced a 403/broken-image. Fixed by making `logo` a SerializerMethodField that returns obj.logo.url (relative). Any future ImageField/FileField exposed through DRF should follow the same pattern in this environment (frontend already prepends REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL when the value is relative).

Assessment version selector groups by 'updated_at' timestamp only — two rapid saves in the same minute render identical labels. Consider adding a monotonic version number or including seconds/id in the label.

rca of the issue: BUG (fixed): Organisation logo did not render in the browser sidebar/header despite the file existing on disk and being served correctly by Django. Reproduction: 1) log in as admin, 2) upload a logo at /settings/organisation, 3) reload — sidebar-org-logo element exists but naturalWidth=0 (broken image). Root cause: DRF's default FileField serialisation calls request.build_absolute_uri(value.url), which uses the request Host header. Behind the k8s ingress the Host is the internal cluster name (verify-badge-dash.cluster-5.preview.emergentcf.cloud) which is not routable from a client browser (returns 403 through the CDN). Frontend logic `org.logo.startsWith('http') ? org.logo : REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL + org.logo` then treated that internal absolute URL as final and used it verbatim. Mitigation: changed OrganisationSerializer.logo to a SerializerMethodField returning obj.logo.url (relative — '/api/media/org/…'). Frontend prepends REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and the browser hits the public ingress URL, image loads (verified naturalWidth>0 for both sidebar-org-logo and header-org-logo in Playwright). Also updated to_internal_value to still accept multipart file uploads for the same 'logo' key (SerializerMethodField would otherwise make it read-only).
